platforms.name: ProgressMe
platforms.note: Official School API Swagger exists. Separately, user-supplied first-party network captures show a private WebSocket RPC surface for book, lesson, exercise, sharing, and user operations; this private contract is not an official public API.

platforms.name: Off2Class
platforms.note: Tutor-facing curriculum, assignments, and student management; no public developer contract for importing books was found.

platforms.name: Diffit
platforms.note: Exports and sharing are UI workflows; no public book/course CRUD API was found.

platforms.name: Twee
platforms.note: Creates and exports ELT resources in the product; no public developer API was found.

platforms.name: Edvibe
platforms.note: Interactive lessons and courses are product features; no public content-import API was found.

platforms.name: LearnCube
platforms.note: Virtual classroom and course materials; no public book CRUD contract was found.

platforms.name: ClassIn
platforms.note: Official API creates courses, LMS units and activities and uploads Cloud Drive files.

platforms.name: Lessonspace
platforms.note: Classroom embeds/integrations exist; no public course/book authoring contract was found.

platforms.name: TutorBird
platforms.note: Tutor administration and resources; no public book authoring API was found.

platforms.name: Koala Go
platforms.note: Lesson rooms and activities; no public course/book CRUD API was found.

platforms.name: YourAgora
platforms.note: Lesson building and assignments are UI features; no public authoring API was found.

platforms.name: Curipod
platforms.note: Creates interactive lessons in-product; no public lesson CRUD API was found.

platforms.name: Brisk Teaching
platforms.note: Generates teaching resources; no public course/book API was found.

platforms.name: MagicSchool
platforms.note: Resource generation is exposed through the product, not a documented public authoring API.

platforms.name: Eduaide.Ai
platforms.note: No public course/book CRUD contract was found.

platforms.name: LessonPlans.ai
platforms.note: No public lesson/course authoring API was found.

platforms.name: Nearpod
platforms.note: Content creation is available in-product; no generally available public content-write contract was verified.

platforms.name: Pear Deck Learning
platforms.note: No generally available public deck/course authoring API was verified.

platforms.name: BookWidgets
platforms.note: Widget authoring is in-product; no public CRUD contract was verified.

platforms.name: LessonUp
platforms.note: No public lesson CRUD API was found.

platforms.name: Genially
platforms.note: Embedding is supported, but a general public content-authoring API was not verified.

platforms.name: Canva for Education
platforms.note: Developer APIs do not expose a verified LMS book/course hierarchy for tutor imports.

platforms.name: Canvas LMS
platforms.note: Official REST APIs create courses, modules, module items, pages and files.

platforms.name: Moodle
platforms.note: Core external functions create courses and upload files; creating a Book/activity requires a custom external service or plugin.

platforms.name: Google Classroom
platforms.note: API creates courses, coursework and materials; it is not a book-authoring API and files are normally supplied through Drive.

platforms.name: Thinkific
platforms.note: Admin API is public, but an end-to-end public contract for creating chapters/content and uploading a book was not verified.

platforms.name: Teachable
platforms.note: Public API coverage is primarily school/business data; complete curriculum authoring/import is not documented as a general API.

platforms.name: Kajabi
platforms.note: Public developer coverage does not expose a verified general book/curriculum import workflow.

platforms.name: LearnWorlds
platforms.note: Official API covers courses and administration; complete learning-activity authoring/upload was not verified.

platforms.name: Podia
platforms.note: No public course/book authoring API was found.

platforms.name: LearnDash
platforms.note: REST v2 supports course/lesson/topic CRUD; exact schema should be downloaded from the installed site's OpenAPI/runtime index.

platforms.name: Tutor LMS Pro
platforms.note: Official Pro REST API documents course/topic/lesson CRUD; uploads use WordPress Media REST.

platforms.name: LifterLMS
platforms.note: Official OpenAPI-backed REST API provides course/section/lesson CRUD; uploads use WordPress Media REST.

platforms.name: TalentLMS
platforms.note: Official API manages courses, but a complete unit/book file-import contract was not verified.

platforms.name: 360Learning
platforms.note: Official API automates courses and external content; native chapter/book authoring coverage is limited.

platforms.name: Docebo
platforms.note: Each tenant exposes an API Browser; content import operations must be taken from that tenant's generated contract.

platforms.name: Absorb LMS
platforms.note: API access and exact operations depend on the customer account; no universal public book-import contract was verified.

platforms.name: Open edX
platforms.note: Course authoring/import is deployment-specific; no stable universal public CRUD API for Studio books was verified.

platforms.name: H5P
platforms.note: H5P packages are portable content units, not a full LMS course/book CRUD service; host-specific APIs apply.

platforms.name: SCORM Cloud
platforms.note: Official API imports SCORM/xAPI/AICC/cmi5 packages and manages registrations; it does not author native books.
